brief_summary: The present project aims to investigate if the empagliflozin has an antiarrhythmic action. Analyzing the T-wave heterogeneity index, a new electrocardiographic risk marker associated with the prediction of cardiovascular risk, in diabetic patients and coronary artery disease, the investigators will verify if empagliflozin is associated with a reduction in electrical instability.
brief_title: Effect of Empagliflozin on Ventricular Repolarization.
official_title: Effect of EMPAgliflozin on The HeterogeneitY of Ventricular Repolarization in Patients With Diabetes and Coronary HEART Disease.
